## Purpose

Read the Shorthouse et al. (2022) metabolomics data and bring it into one
injection-level and one cell-line-level object, keyed by injection (`dsIdx`)
and ion (`ionIdx`). No transformation, normalisation or imputation is applied
here; the published intensities are already normalised (see Methods).

## Inputs

- `data/raw/cancer-cell-lines/msb202211006-sup-0002-datasetev1.xlsx` (Dataset EV1): one or more rows per injection with cell line name and Cellosaurus fields
- `…-sup-0003-datasetev2.xlsx` (Dataset EV2): candidate metabolite annotations per ion
- `…-sup-0004-datasetev3.xlsx` (Dataset EV3): intensities, ions × injections
- `analyses/cancer-cell-lines/config/config.yml`: excluded and merged lines

## Methods

Metabolite levels of cancer cell lines were taken from Shorthouse et al.
(2022), who reanalysed the flow-injection mass spectrometry data of Cherkaoui
et al. (2022). The published intensities (Dataset EV3) were already corrected
for injection order and plate confluence by Lowess smoothing, and ions
associated with batch or plate were removed by the authors. Injections were
matched to cell lines through the injection index of Dataset EV1. Candidate
metabolite annotations (Dataset EV2) were collapsed per ion. The quality
control line MCF7 was removed, as in the original study. Additional cultures of
the same cell line (COR-L88, MDA-MB-231, NCI-H441) were merged. Intensities
were averaged (arithmetic mean) over all injections of a cell line, following
the original study.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)

# helpers of the use case: configuration, filter log, manifest, previews
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/use_case.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/plotting.R"))
config <- load_config()
raw_dir <- uc_dir(config, "raw")
derived_dir <- uc_dir(config, "derived")
output_dir <- uc_dir(config, "output", "01_import_shorthouse")

# the three published tables, file names from config.yml
files <- vapply(config$shorthouse$files, function(f) file.path(raw_dir, f), "")

# every step that removes injections, ions or lines is recorded here
filter_log <- NULL
```

## Read the published tables

```{r read}
# all three tables are on "Sheet1"; the second sheet only holds a legend
ev1 <- read_xlsx(files[["injections"]], sheet = "Sheet1")
ev2 <- read_xlsx(files[["ions"]], sheet = "Sheet1")
ev3 <- read_xlsx(files[["intensities"]], sheet = "Sheet1")

c(ev1_rows = nrow(ev1), ev2_rows = nrow(ev2), ev3_ions = nrow(ev3), ev3_injections = ncol(ev3) - 1)
```

```{r preview-raw}
preview_table(ev1, caption = "EV1: injections (one or more rows per injection)")
preview_table(ev2, caption = "EV2: candidate annotations (several rows per ion)")
preview_table(ev3, rows = 50, cols = 20, caption = "EV3: intensities, ions (rows) × injections (columns)")
```

## Injections

EV1 has several rows for some injections, differing only in the Cellosaurus
fields. They are combined to one row per injection; the cell line name must be
the same in all rows of an injection.

```{r injections}
# check: an injection never belongs to two cell lines
stopifnot(all(tapply(ev1$celltype, ev1$dsIdx, function(x) length(unique(x)) == 1)))

# combine the distinct, non-empty values of a field ("NA"/"NS" are placeholders in EV1)
collapse_unique <- function(x) {
    x <- unique(x[!is.na(x) & !x %in% c("", "NA", "NS")])
    if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(x, collapse = " || ")
}

# one row per injection; keep the fields needed to identify the cell line
injections <- ev1 %>%
    group_by(dsIdx) %>%
    summarise(
        name = first(celltype),
        rrid = collapse_unique(RRID),            # Cellosaurus accession given by the authors
        cellosaurus_id = collapse_unique(ID),    # Cellosaurus name given by the authors
        disease_ev1 = collapse_unique(DI),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # the injection index is the column name in EV3
    mutate(injection_id = as.character(dsIdx))

nrow(injections)
preview_table(injections, caption = "Injections after combining EV1 rows")
```

## Ions

```{r ions}
# combine the distinct values of a field, separated by "; "
clean_collapse <- function(x) {
    x <- unique(x[!is.na(x) & !x %in% c("NA", "NS")])
    str_c(x, collapse = "; ")
}

# EV2 lists every candidate metabolite of an ion as its own row;
# collapse them to one row per ion
ions <- ev2 %>%
    mutate(name = str_replace_all(name, " ", "_")) %>%
    group_by(ionIdx) %>%
    summarise(
        ionMz   = first(ionMz),
        hmdb    = clean_collapse(HMDB),
        kegg    = clean_collapse(KEGG),
        score   = clean_collapse(score),
        formula = clean_collapse(formula),
        ion     = clean_collapse(ion),
        name    = clean_collapse(name),
        id_list = clean_collapse(c(HMDB, KEGG)),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # key used by all later steps (also the column names of the intensity matrix)
    mutate(feature_id = paste0("V", ionIdx))

# every ion has at least one HMDB or KEGG identifier
stopifnot(!any(ions$id_list == ""))
nrow(ions)
preview_table(ions, caption = "Ions after collapsing the candidate annotations")
```

Three pairs of ions with different m/z carry the same metabolite annotation
(measured as -H and +F adducts). As in the original pipeline, the later ion of
each pair is dropped (`drop_duplicate_annotation_ions`).

```{r duplicate-ions}
# ions whose identifier list repeats that of an earlier ion
duplicate_ions <- ions %>%
    filter(duplicated(id_list)) %>%
    pull(ionIdx)

# show both ions of each pair
ions %>%
    filter(id_list %in% id_list[ionIdx %in% duplicate_ions]) %>%
    select(ionIdx, ionMz, ion, name) %>%
    preview_table(caption = "Ion pairs with the same annotation")

n_before <- nrow(ions)
if (isTRUE(config$shorthouse$drop_duplicate_annotation_ions)) {
    ions <- filter(ions, !ionIdx %in% duplicate_ions)
}
filter_log <- log_filter(filter_log, "duplicate annotation", "ions", n_before, nrow(ions),
                         "same HMDB/KEGG annotation as an earlier ion")
```

## Intensities

The intensity matrix is built as injections × ions, with rows named by
`dsIdx` and columns by `V<ionIdx>`; all later steps match by these names.

```{r intensities}
# check: one row per ion in EV3, and EV3 has exactly the injections of EV1
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ev3$ionIdx), setequal(setdiff(names(ev3), "ionIdx"), injections$injection_id))

# select injection columns by name (not position), transpose to injections × ions
intensities <- t(as.matrix(ev3[, injections$injection_id]))
colnames(intensities) <- paste0("V", ev3$ionIdx)
storage.mode(intensities) <- "double"

# keep the ions retained above, selected by key
intensities <- intensities[, ions$feature_id]

c(missing = sum(is.na(intensities)), negative = sum(intensities < 0), zero = sum(intensities == 0))
preview_table(intensities, rows = 50, cols = 20, caption = "Intensities, injections × ions")
```

EV3 contains no missing values. Negative and zero values are kept here; how
they are handled is decided in the data inventory (Audit 1).

## Lines

```{r lines}
# remove the QC line(s) listed in config.yml (MCF7), as in the original study
n_before <- nrow(injections)
injections <- filter(injections, !name %in% config$shorthouse$exclude_lines)
filter_log <- log_filter(filter_log, "exclude lines", "injections", n_before, nrow(injections),
                         paste("excluded lines:", paste(config$shorthouse$exclude_lines, collapse = ", ")))
intensities <- intensities[injections$injection_id, ]

# names of additional cultures are mapped to the name of their cell line
merge_map <- unlist(config$shorthouse$merge_lines)
stopifnot(all(names(merge_map) %in% injections$name), all(merge_map %in% injections$name))
injections <- injections %>%
    mutate(line = coalesce(unname(merge_map[name]), name))

# one row per cell line, with the number of injections behind it
lines <- injections %>%
    group_by(line) %>%
    summarise(
        member_names = paste(sort(unique(name)), collapse = "; "),
        n_injections = n(),
        rrid = collapse_unique(rrid),
        cellosaurus_id = collapse_unique(cellosaurus_id),
        disease_ev1 = collapse_unique(disease_ev1),
        .groups = "drop"
    )
filter_log <- log_filter(filter_log, "merge lines", "lines", n_distinct(injections$name), nrow(lines),
                         "additional cultures of the same cell line merged")

# mean over all injections of a line: sum per line divided by the number of injections
line_of_injection <- injections$line[match(rownames(intensities), injections$injection_id)]
line_intensities <- rowsum(intensities, line_of_injection)
line_intensities <- line_intensities / as.vector(table(injections$line)[rownames(line_intensities)])
line_intensities <- line_intensities[lines$line, ]

# check: rows and columns match the line and ion tables
stopifnot(identical(rownames(line_intensities), lines$line), identical(colnames(line_intensities), ions$feature_id))
table(lines$n_injections)
preview_table(lines, caption = "Cell lines")
preview_table(line_intensities, rows = 50, cols = 20, caption = "Mean intensities, lines × ions")
```

## Outputs

```{r save}
injection_data <- list(intensities = intensities, injections = injections, ions = ions)
line_data <- list(intensities = line_intensities, lines = lines, ions = ions)

out <- c(
    injections = file.path(derived_dir, "01_injections.rds"),
    lines = file.path(derived_dir, "01_lines.rds")
)
saveRDS(injection_data, out[["injections"]])
saveRDS(line_data, out[["lines"]])
write.csv(filter_log, file.path(output_dir, "filter_log.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# manifest: input/output checksums, git commit, package versions, parameters
write_manifest(out, files, file.path(derived_dir, "01_manifest.json"),
               extra = list(exclude_lines = config$shorthouse$exclude_lines, merge_lines = config$shorthouse$merge_lines))

preview_table(filter_log, caption = "All filtering steps of this notebook")
```

## Interpretation

The import keeps every published ion except the three duplicate annotations
and every injection except those of the excluded QC line. The cell-line matrix
is on the published (normalised, untransformed) scale; the number of
injections behind each line is kept in `lines$n_injections`, because it varies
between lines (most have 6, the QC line MDA-MB-231 has 78 after merging).

sessionInfo()
